text:
Recent work supports separating semantic resemblance from directional purchase usefulness. [MERLIN (CIKM 2024)](https://assets.amazon.science/64/e7/c9c13a75471c9606b67d8fc3ea0d/merlin-multimodal-multilingual-embedding-for-recommendations-at-large-scale-via-item-associations.pdf) models asymmetric item associations with separate product representations for source and destination roles. [TransGAT (ICDM 2024)](https://www.amazon.science/publications/transitivity-encoded-graph-attention-networks-for-complementary-item-recommendations) encodes behavioral direction and jointly learns complement and substitute graphs. These motivate asymmetric scoring, but their relationship signals cannot automatically be recovered from this task’s histories. Observed transitions are predictive evidence, not verified complement/substitute labels.

[Revisiting Graph Projections (2025)](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.09209v1) offers a particularly relevant lightweight approach: combine a normalized user–item graph projection with directed, inverse-distance-weighted counts of subsequent interactions within a short window. Its category-level transition smoothing addresses sparsity, but requires unavailable item categories; an experimental replacement could use clusters learned from permitted titles/descriptions. Reported Amazon improvements concern Beauty, Sports, Toys and Books, providing no direct evidence for Electronics or the pinned sampled-candidate HR@10 protocol. [CGH-SBR (2025)](https://www.mdpi.com/2073-8994/17/3/389) likewise combines directed cross-session transitions with higher-order co-occurrence structure to address sparse histories.

Practical inference: test a small directed-transition residual alongside SASRec, using training histories only, separate source/target embeddings, distance weighting and support-based shrinkage. For Electronics, phone→accessory illustrates why semantic proximity alone may miss useful successors; actual gains remain unverified. Treat title/description similarity as optional smoothing rather than complement supervision. Retain separate routing for all four datasets and select residual strength using macro validation HR@10. Compare directed versus symmetric edges and transition-only versus semantic smoothing to establish which signal helps.
